label: gate
definition: The bar a change must pass before it lands: the project's check command run on the branch's tree with the current base in it. Here it is bash scripts/check.sh; in a scaffolded project it is tasks.check. A red gate is never merged; the captain fixes the cause or reports it.
is_not: One check: the gate is the set of checks, run together, with one pass or fail.
CI: CI is the gate's second run, after the PR is up; the first run is local, before the PR opens.
MERGEABLE on GitHub: that says the branch combines without a textual conflict, not that the gate passed on the combined tree.
